comment: Hypothesized pairwise bans, not proven laws. The note's example is ultra-low power together with high-performance / full-scale compute. MCMC estimates how much co-occurrence data support each ban. Empty cells are not automatically forbidden.

high-performance compute + tiny footprint; strained pairing used as a second test
